messages:
Maya L.: reopening the spend layout thread — noticed during testing that on narrow screens the invoice download CTA is getting pushed off-screen and users miss it. can we decide where CTA and scope toggle should live?

Josh K.: yeah saw that too. mobile view currently stacks: chart, tokens, then actions. users expect an invoice/download affordance near the top.

Elaine (Design): quick mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/spend-compact-cta — proposal A pins the invoice CTA to the header (under scope toggle), proposal B moves the CTA into a floating FAB on small screens.

Samir: prefer pinned header for discoverability, but worried about visual weight. if pinned, we should reduce CTA prominence (outline) and use copy "Download invoices" not just "Invoice".

Oliver P.: product note — default scope for org-admins should still be org view, but when in project view the header CTA should switch to "Download project invoices". also want telemetry for clicks.

Elaine (Design): agree on copy. accessibility: CTA needs role=button and aria-label that includes scope, e.g., "Download invoices for Acme Corp (org)".

Maya L.: what about the spend breakdown visual? users also said token bubbles are noisy; asked for a compact numeric breakdown. can we show condensed chips + a toggle to expand to the bubble chart?

Josh K.: toggle makes sense. default to compact table (denser) on small widths. larger screens show bubbles by default.

Samir: small nit — when we collapse tokens into chips, still surface the top 3 token types with hover-to-expand. also keep a keyboard-focus state for each chip.

Elaine (Design): mock update: added chips row + "More" chevron. also added focus styles and high-contrast outlines.

design-bot: attachment: screenshot-2054321000-v2.png (uploaded)

Oliver P.: question about scope toggle placement: left rail vs top toolbar. analytics shows most customers use top toolbar for quick switching. I'd vote top so CTA and scope are adjacent.

Maya L.: top toolbar it is then. but we should ensure the top bar doesn't become too tall on mobile — propose single-line with overflow: ellipsis for project name and a small kebab for actions.

Josh K.: implementation note: will need to change header DOM so CTA is position:sticky; z-index above chart. fallback: if sticky not supported, show FAB.

Samir: for the A/B experiment: A = pinned header CTA, compact tokens default; B = floating FAB CTA, bubble chart default. track invoice-download, token-expand, and scope-switch metrics.

Elaine (Design): will update Figma and generate new handoff. tagging @engineering-design for accessibility review.

Maya L.: timeline? can we get a PR for the header changes by next sprint for product review?

Josh K.: yes, I'll pick it up. will create RFC PR and link tickets for telemetry.

Oliver P.: thanks everyone — I'll set up the A/B in LaunchDarkly and share experiment doc. :thumbsup:

Samir: quick accessibility follow-up: ensure invoice filename still contains org/project and ISO date for screen-reader users who inspect the filename.

Elaine (Design): good call, adding that to the spec.

Maya L.: awesome. closing this thread after mocks are pushed.
